question: Rigveda consists of a collection of ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is__ __**__1028 hymns__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **In** Rigveda, there are **1028 hymns, which are organized into ten books.**
 
• **These books are known as maṇḍalas**.
 
• Each and every **maṇḍala** consist of sūktas (hymns) .
 
• This suktas are formed by individual strophes .
 
• According to history, It can be said that **Vyasa **is the compiler of the Vedas.
 
• Who arranged the four kinds of mantras into four Samhitas.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** ****Samaveda**:

 
 
• This consists of 1549 verses.
 
• It is the storehouse of the melodious chants.
 
 
 
• **Yajurved**:
 
 
• The meaning of this ved is 'Worship Knowledge'.
 
• It has two parts -Krishna and Sukla.
